description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 Order under Section 2
categorisation: This gazette notification imposes a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes regulatory requirements and tax rates for specific commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities but rather on his exercise of statutory powers to implement a regulatory measure.
